maj8_continuous_method: continuous templates (xy2d, depth) have no well-defined modal answer; maj@8 uses the component-wise median predicted point (xy2d) / median of range-midpoints (depth), re-scored with score_surds.score_one.
pass_at_k_estimator: 1 - C(n-c, k)/C(n, k) = 1 - prod_{i=n-c+1..n}(1 - k/i), averaged over questions
